---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a bounded improvement for a current user or contributor
title: "enhancement: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

Use [Ideas Discussions](https://github.com/AoiOTA/Kiss-My-Agent/discussions/categories/ideas) while the need or outcome is still open-ended. Do not disclose vulnerabilities or private data here; follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) instead.

## Problem and current consumer

Who has this problem now, what are they trying to do, and what concrete failure or friction occurs?

## Desired outcome

Describe the observable result. State acceptance criteria without prescribing extra machinery.

## Smallest useful change

What is the smallest interface, behavior, or documentation change that could deliver the outcome?

## Existing behavior and alternatives

What current path did you try? Link relevant documentation, issues, Rules, Cases, or code and explain why they are insufficient.

## Compatibility and migration

Could this affect installation, setup scope, existing roles, configuration, plugin/marketplace metadata, or documented commands?

## Evidence

Provide the smallest safe example, source inspection, or reproduction that supports the need. Separate observed facts from expectations.

## Non-goals

List adjacent behavior this proposal must not add or change.
